summary: Cycurion filed a routine Form 8-K under Items 8.01 and 9.01 furnishing two press releases dated September 30 and October 2, 2026. The disclosure consists of an investor interview discussing a previously announced 10-year, $54.6 million contract award expected to generate over $5 million in annual revenue, the acquisition of Digital Ally's Video Solutions business, and public safety expansion. No new special-situation transaction, securities offering, shareholder vote, or board-level corporate event is announced. The filing chronicles general business developments and attaches exhibits; no deal terms, advisor, or board recommendation are stated.
